title: Physics
description: Numerical physics: spectra, transforms, simulations, fits to physical models.

applies_when.always_for: claims that rest on a physical formula, a transform of a signal, or a simulation of a physical system

trace_targets: The formula in code against the derivation, the cited paper or a textbook: normalisation, units, signs, factors of 2 and 2pi, Jacobians of a change of variables, which array enters the formula.
recompute_recipes: Parseval: integrate a saved PSD and compare with the time-domain variance.
Convert one reported number to the other unit or variable (Hz to nm, B_nu to B_lambda) and compare.
Check a conserved quantity (energy, norm, probability) along a saved trajectory.
